{{Top}}
{{Otheruses|Bolt}}
[[File:Threepio_restraining_bolt.png|thumb|right|225px|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] fitted with a restraining bolt on his right chestplate]]
{{Quote|Fit him with a restraining bolt and take him back to His Excellency's main audience chamber.|[[EV-9D9/Legends|EV-9D9]], regarding [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]|<ref name="Episode 6">{{Film|VI}}</ref>}}
A '''restraining bolt''', also known as a '''restraining separator bolt''', was a small device that could be attached to most [[Droid/Legends|droids]] used to ensure their obedience. More specifically, when fitted with a restraining bolt, droids could not leave the area designated by their owner, and were forced to obey commands given from a small remote device called a [[Droid caller/Legends|caller]] (such as "COME" and "STOP"). When activated, the restraining bolt turned off a droid's motor impulse without actually shutting down the droid. Restraining bolts had to be secured to specific locations on the droid.

Restraining bolts could also be used to shut down a droid, and power it back up again. This could be used to force a restart if there was an error in the droid's memory. The shut down could be accomplished with a switch on the bolt, or through the use of the caller. [[Kell Tainer]] helped [[Myn Donos]] restart his droid [[Shiner]] using this method after [[Empion mine]]s had disabled the squadron.

The [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] tricked his new owner [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] into removing his restraining bolt, so that he could leave the [[Lars homestead/Legends|Lars homestead]] and seek out [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] were also fitted with restraining bolts during the [[Bakura/Legends|Bakuran]] Crisis. The assassin/protocol droid [[HK-47]] also had a restraining bolt, so that he could not leave the droid shop until he was purchased and collected. [[Whistler]], [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn's]] R2 unit, had a unique mechanism which shifted control points internally, allowing the droid to avoid being controlled by restraining bolts at all. [[EV-9D9/Legends|EV-9D9]] also modified herself so as to be immune to restraining bolts, and (for obvious reasons) security droids such as the [[G-2RD series guard droid|G-2RD]] could not be disabled by standard restraining bolts.

[[Droid rights/Legends|Droid rights activists]] abhorred use of the technology but supporters of [[Anti-droid sentiment/Legends|anti-droid sentiment]] embraced it.
